original_sentence: I remember hearing in high school, "Don't worry about losing friendships, just focus on study and getting into college. That's all that will matter in the long run," a sentiment that is not unique to my experience.
translation: 我记得高中时听到过这样的话：“别担心失去友谊，只要专注学习、考上大学就行。从长远来看，只有这些才重要。”这种看法并非我个人经历独有。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: in the long run 在本句中对应"从长远看"。
not unique to 在本句中对应"并非……独有"。
get into college 在本句中对应"进入大学"。
worry about 在本句中对应"担心"。
focus on 在本句中对应"关注；聚焦于"。
